entities.title: Windows and macOS builds
entities.summary: The Windows and macOS libraries and exports have never been built.
entities.cause: The library has to be built on each platform (or by a CI runner with its Rust target), and the work so far was done on Linux only. The goal is a runnable Windows build with lodestar_godot.dll and a signed universal macOS app with liblodestar_godot.dylib.
entities.unblockWhen: A Windows and a macOS machine, or CI runners for them, build the library and the export.

entities.title: cargo test and export starts on every pull request
entities.summary: No workflow tests or exports LodeStar.
entities.cause: Every pull request should run cargo test and a headless start of each platform's export, but the repository's game workflow runs only games with a package.json (changed-games.sh) and has no Windows or macOS runners.
entities.unblockWhen: A workflow job for LodeStar, with Linux, Windows and macOS runners, is added to .github/workflows.
entities.canUnblock: The owner, who approves workflow changes
